description: This file defines a React component for inserting remote images into a Lexical editor, including a dialog component for user input and a plugin component for handling editor commands.

classes.name: InsertRemoteImageDialog
classes.description: A React component that renders a dialog allowing users to input an image URL and insert it into the editor.

classes.name: RemoteImagePlugin
classes.description: A React component plugin that registers a command to insert remote image nodes into the Lexical editor context.

methods.name: InsertRemoteImageDialog
methods.description: Component for rendering a dialog to input image URL and trigger image insertion.

methods.name: RemoteImagePlugin
methods.description: Plugin component that registers a command to insert remote images into the editor.
